abilities.name: Immersive Ordinance
abilities.description:
Time for a fun little trick! Summons the Sacramental Shower in different ways depending on whether you Tap or Hold it.

Tap
After a short prayer, summons the Sacramental Shower in front.

Hold
Engages in continuous prayer, and when done, summons forth a Sacramental Shower in the designated position.

Sacramental Shower
When opponents or nearby party members touch the Sacramental Shower, different effects will occur depending on the one who touches it:
If an opponent touches the Shower, it will explode and deal AoE Hydro DMG to nearby opponents.
If a nearby party member touches it, it will bounce the one who touches it high in the air.

Only 1 Sacramental Shower summoned by Dahlia himself can be on the field at once.
abilities.caveat: Sacramental Shower lifetime not rendered on the timeline. The entity is touch-triggered (party members bounce, opponents explode) and its duration isn't modelled in gcsim or available from a canonical source — surfacing a fabricated window would mislead.
_curatorNotes: Sacramental Shower summons[] entries removed (was duration: 0 placeholder). gcsim doesn't track the entity's lifetime and we have no other authoritative source. Re-add when KQM / in-game data lands; spawnsAt was 27 (Tap) / 28 (Hold).
Hold E (hE) cooldownStartDelay=21 differs from Tap cooldownStartDelay=23. Schema gap: AbilityVariant has no cooldownStartDelay field; reviewer decides whether to extend schema.

abilities.name: Radiant Psalter
abilities.description:
Appeals to the divine with earnestness and song, dealing AoE Hydro DMG to nearby opponents and granting his party members Favonian Favor, summoning a Shield of Sacred Favor.
The Shield of Sacred Favor's DMG absorption is based on Dahlia's Max HP, and it will absorb Hydro DMG with 250% effectiveness.

Favonian Favor
While this effect is active, 1 Benison stack may be consumed to summon a new Shield of Sacred Favor when an existing Shield is broken via DMG.

Dahlia can obtain Benison via the following methods:
· He will gain 1 Benison stack when his own active party member hits opponents 4 times with Normal Attacks while affected by Favonian Favor.
· After triggering the effect of his Ascension Talent, "The Wind's Gentle Grace" (You must first unlock this Ascension Talent.)
Dahlia can gain a maximum of 4 Benison stacks per Favonian Favor duration.
_curatorNotes: Favonian Favor is a 12s duration-bounded self-status (C4 extends to 15s, gcsim: favonianFavorDuration = 12*60 + c4FavonianFavorBonusDur()). Not modeled as summons[] — no spawned entity in world space. Shield of Sacred Favor first applies at frame 31 (burstShieldInitial) and regenerates from Benison stacks (max 4 per Favonian Favor window; gained via 4 NA hits on-field or 2 via A1 Frozen trigger). Reviewer to author Favonian Favor ATK SPD self-buff, shield effect, and Benison stack tracking.

_curatorNotes: Likely onReaction trigger with reaction: 'frozen'. Condition: Favonian Favor must be active on Dahlia (burstFavonianFavor status). ICD: 8s (gcsim: benisonStackGenerationIcd). Grants Dahlia 2 Benison stacks. No team-visible buff — internal stack accrual only. Reaction list needs KQM verification.
passives.description: When characters affected by the Favonian Favor effect of the Elemental Burst **Radiant Psalter** trigger Frozen reactions on opponents, they will grant Dahlia 2 Benison stacks. This effect can trigger once every 8s.

passives.name: Prayer of Well-Wrought Joy
_curatorNotes: Scaling buff — ATK SPD scales with Dahlia's Max HP: 0.5% per 1,000 Max HP (gcsim: min(MaxHP*0.001*0.005, 0.2)), cap 20%. target: active character under Favonian Favor. C6 adds a flat 10% on top (uncapped). No value field authored (scaling buff second pass).
passives.description: When your active party member is affected by the Favonian Favor effect of the Elemental Burst **"Radiant Psalter,"** their ATK SPD will increase based on Dahlia's Max HP: Every 1,000 Max HP will cause an increase of 0.5%, up to a maximum of 20%.

constellations.name: You Shall Go Out With Joy
_curatorNotes: Two effects: (1) ATK SPD +10% (flat) for active character under Favonian Favor — additive with A4 HP-scaling ATK SPD, so C6 cap is effectively 30% (gcsim: burstAttackSpeed = min(HP-based, 0.2) + 0.1). (2) Revival mechanic: revive fallen character affected by Favonian Favor to 100% HP, once per 15 minutes (gcsim: c6Icd = 15*60*60 frames). Neither effect yet authored — needs reviewer pass.
constellations.description:
The current active character affected by the Elemental Burst **Radiant Psalter**'s Favonian Favor has their ATK SPD increased by 10%.
Additionally, when an active character affected by Favonian Favor falls, immediately:
· Revive them.
· Restore their HP to 100%.
This effect can trigger once every 15 minutes.
